text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "The Official Publications Centre (OPC) provides support to the Federal Council Affairs Section and is responsible for legislation on administrative organisation, the consultation procedure and publications.", "gist": "OPC supports Federal Council Affairs Section and handles legislation on administrative organisation, consultation procedure, and publications"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Official Publications Centre (OPC)", "gist": "OPC is an entity"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The Official Publications Centre plays a key role in the Federal Administration, helping the federal offices to prepare texts for publication in the Federal Gazette or the Official Compilation, and keeping law texts in the Classified Compilation up to date.", "gist": "OPC is key in Federal Administration for preparing publication texts and updating law texts"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Central Language Services, German Section", "gist": "German Section of Central Language Services is an entity"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The German Section in the Federal Chancellery Central Language Services ensures the clarity of official texts and contributes to the success of multilingual official communication.", "gist": "German Section ensures clarity of official texts and supports multilingual communication success"}]}
